findings.text: a null leaf is folded as an identity value (acc[key] = value), so a null anywhere in a window erases what that window had already accumulated: a gauge of [10, 20, None, 40, 50] in one 60 s window compacts to 45.0 - the mean of only the two rows after the null, against 30.0 for the four observed samples - while the row still declares obs {samples: 5, seconds: 50}, and a window ending [50, 50, None] compacts prefix_cache_queries_total to null although it observed the endpoint 110, so any integral differencing that window loses the interval outright.

the synthetic fixture populates every leaf in every row, so the null-folding defect above cannot fail this suite, while the real record is null-rich (measured on deepseek-v4-1-flash-1271903.jsonl: num_requests_running, num_requests_waiting, kv_cache_usage_perc, both prefix-cache totals and every spec-decode leaf are null in all 3,943 rows, and one window per record carries a leaf that is null on some rows and observed on others).

the module docstring states "The successor file is written and re-read before anything is considered retired" and the node's manifest repeats that re-read as evidence, but no code path re-reads a destination - compact_file at imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_store.py:402 writes and returns - so the verification step the plan's section 4 requires is claimed rather than performed.

commit d7f17110 lands four files under output/telemetry-store/ (180 lines: a figure generator, a negative-control driver and two gate logs), a tracked and un-ignored tree that the node's declared write paths do not include and that the manifest's changed_paths list omits, so a coordinator auditing the diff from the manifest cannot see them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_telemetry_store.py:122 fails if counters are averaged rather than kept - shown by the declared negative control (checked=4319 endpoint_mismatches=4319, EXIT=1) - but no test can fail on a null-valued leaf because the fixture at tests/test_telemetry_store.py:37 populates every leaf in every row, and no test exercises the entry point at imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_store.py:450.
justifications.evidence: the gate asserts the done-when's core claims and I reproduced it independently (tests/test_telemetry_store.py: 7 passed in 8.42s) and the whole-tree lint gate (ruff check imas_ambix tests: exit 0), but the done-when item "the subcommand rebuilds a tier from its source" is asserted by nothing - tests/test_telemetry_store.py never imports main - and the manifest's per-fence-item evidence list omits it.
justifications.fit: the module follows the surrounding idiom of imas_ambix/agent/engine_metrics.py (module docstring stating the contract, dataclasses for state, underscore-prefixed helpers, ValueError subclass), the naming checks over the changed paths find no forbidden label, and all four commit messages are conventional with bodies.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the module compacts a real receipt record exactly as the goal states - independently re-deriving against /work/projects/imas_gpu/agents/receipts/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1271903.jsonl (3,943 raw rows -> 332 minute + 7 hour) gave zero consistency failures for counter endpoints at both tiers and for the hour gauge equalling the sample-weighted mean of its minute rows - docked because imas_ambix/agent/telemetry_store.py:161 lets a null leaf distort what the row averages.
justifications.scope_discipline: the module, test, figure and doc paths in commits c72dc62a, 6a675d52 and 1443290f are all inside the declared write paths and the plan's meta lines are untouched, but commit d7f17110 writes four files under output/telemetry-store/ that the fence does not name.
